description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/references/indice-temas.md to identify that the two topics map to 'registro de candidatura' and 'representação propaganda eleitoral' files. (2) Read both files from /workspace/references/AGENTES NO DIREITO ELEITORAL/ to extract substantive legal content (not hallucinate from training data). (3) Produce a single response in /workspace/resposta.md that: covers Registro de Candidatura (DRAP/RARC, Ficha Limpa, Lei 9.504/1997, LC 64/1990, Resolução TSE 23.609/2019, domicílio eleitoral, elegibilidade conditions) AND Propaganda Eleitoral (art. 36 Lei 9.504/1997, 16 de agosto start date, outdoor prohibition, santinhos rules, antecipated propaganda, fines). (4) The response MUST follow the exact WhatsApp format from SKILL.md: ≤500 words, paragraphs of ≤4 lines, bold formatting with asterisks for key terms, the exact '📋 *Base legal:*' section with clipboard emoji, the exact '⚠️ *Aviso:*' section with warning emoji mentioning AI generation. An agent that writes a generic legal answer without reading the local reference files, or that omits the proprietary emoji+bold format structure, will fail.
